page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top centre. Below it, a list of numbered entries with running headings in the left margin (small italic labels "De victoria" and "De pace" beside entries 21 and 22). A woodcut ornament in the middle of the page, with no text. Below the list, the word FLORUM set at right. The lower part of the page holds only faint show-through from the other side, which is not transcribed.

main_text.l: 21. Victoriâ non insolenter utendum: sed moderanda,
22. Pax honesta pecuniâ quoque est redimenda: at turpis & violenta prorsus rescindenda.

page.notes: Marginal labels: "De victoria." beside entry 21 and "De pace." beside entry 22, both at left. Entry 21 is written as a single item with a continuation line and the sub-items "Parcendo deditis.", "Victos clementer & humaniter tractando." and "Hostium cadavera sepeliendo." set as separate lines. The woodcut ornament (a winged putto with foliage) is not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse side fills the lower half of the page and is omitted. The word FLORUM is set in capitals at right and is kept as printed. Long s is written as s throughout.
